attributes.context: The clause appears as Section 28, captioned “New Work Classification,” within a CBA passage that also covers hazardous waste site wages and safety, higher-rate classifications, holidays, and holiday pay.

extraction_text: If during the term of this Agreement, mechanized changes or changes in the method of operation result in different or new types of work, the Employer and the Unions agree to negotiate a new work classification and wage rates for such work.

attributes.context: The surrounding article provides that the Construction Specialist will perform job-site-specific duties and receive hourly compensation generally reflecting New Jersey prevailing wage rates, and that any project-specific implementation and compensation require unanimous agreement of a committee of two employer and two union representatives.

extraction_text: To ensure that the needs of new technology and future competitive requirements are met, there is hereby established the work classification of Construction Specialist. For implicit clarification of the intent of this Article and classification, there can be no unilateral implementation of the Construction Specialist.
